title: A re-submit after a failed batch charges quota and the provider again while the old batch runs on until the 1 h sweep
evidence: Try again creates a new batch: the route charges quota again (app/routes/api.lab-import-v2.ts consumeQuota before createBatch) and pays the provider again. The old batch is cancelled only by the sweep (app/lib/lab-batches.server.ts, 60-70 min); if it already finished, both are paid for. No duplicate rows (review dedup). Owner ruling Q5 (C18): no early provider cancel for now
